discrepancies.details: NIRF 2026 submission reports 508 patents published in calendar year 2024 (Overall; 505 in Engineering), 122 in 2023, 76 in 2022. The VIT IPR Cell list 'Published Patents from 2015 to 2025' contains only 152 entries for 2024, about 66-67 for 2023 and 25 for 2022 (371 in total, 2015 to Feb 2025). The two official VIT sources disagree by a large margin for 2024. Possible reasons (not confirmed): different counting bases such as including co-applicant or third-party data, or the IPR list being incomplete.

Patents published in CY2022: 76 in Overall NIRF 2024/2025/2026 submissions vs 75 in the Engineering NIRF 2026 submission; CY2023: 122 (Overall) vs 121 (Engineering); CY2024: 508 (Overall) vs 505 (Engineering). The small gaps are plausibly because the Engineering category covers only engineering programmes.
PhD full-time graduates in 2022-23: 214 per NIRF 2024 and NIRF 2025 Overall submissions, but 318 per NIRF 2026 Overall submission (part-time 16 vs 14).

Consultancy amounts differ between submissions: FY2022-23 Rs 2,85,64,438 (NIRF 2024) vs Rs 2,85,18,894 (NIRF 2025/2026); FY2021-22 Rs 2,20,15,325 (NIRF 2024 and Engineering 2025) vs Rs 2,20,02,689 (Overall NIRF 2025).

UG 4-year placement for the same cohorts differs between Overall and Engineering NIRF 2025 submissions: 2021-22 placed 4199, median Rs 8,10,000 (Overall) vs 4212, median Rs 8,00,000 (Engineering); 2022-23 placed 5055 (Overall) vs 4923 (Engineering).

Sponsored research FY2023-24: Engineering-category submission reports 177 projects and Rs 27,49,67,689, which is more money than the institution-wide Overall submission (201 projects, Rs 20,28,68,433). An engineering subset should not exceed the whole.

VIT's Ranking and Recognition page states 'VIT is ranked 691st globally in the QS World University Rankings 2027', while the VIT Milestones page gives 691 for QS WUR 2026 and the VIT blog (18 Jun 2026) gives 597 for QS WUR 2027 (up 94 places, consistent with 691 being the 2026 rank). The ranking page probably mislabels the edition. Could not check on topuniversities.com (blocked).

QS subject rankings: the VIT Milestones page (2025 section) lists Engineering & Technology 142, CS & IS 110, Materials 151-200, Mathematics 201-250 and more, while the Ranking and Recognition page lists QS Subject 2026 as E&T 119, CS & IS 86, Materials 137, Mathematics 104. They appear to be different editions (the Milestones page does not name its subject-ranking edition). The VIT homepage says 119th in E&T.

VIT's accreditation PDF (reached via https://vit.ac.in/accreditation; PDF metadata dated 20-Feb-2020) says ABET has accredited 14 B.Tech programmes. ABET's public database shows 11 current program records (13 including historical variants) for VIT University (Vellore), all with accreditation ending 30-Sep-2021, and no currently accredited programmes. The same PDF also refers to NAAC 'A' grade in three cycles, which is superseded by the Cycle 4 A++ (2021).

THE profile description (institution-supplied text) mentions VIT being recognised as an Institution of Eminence (IoE) by MHRD. Government sources (PIB, Sep 2019) confirm only a Letter of Intent to VIT; no final IoE declaration for VIT was found.

2025 batch students placed: 11550 in the CDC Highlights graphic (as on 10-07-2025) vs 11352 for 2025 in the CDC Placement Tracker graphic (as on 27-Mar-2026). The homepage's undated figures (14044 overall offers, 868 companies, 3499 Dream, 3003 Super Dream, 560 Marquee) differ from the 2025-batch graphic (14268 offers, 1079 companies, 3575 Dream, 3032 Super Dream, 572 Marquee).

CDC figures cover all four VIT campuses (Vellore, Chennai, AP, Bhopal) and include internships, whereas NIRF placement data is for VIT Vellore only (for example, UG 4-year 2024-25: 7023 placed out of 11913 graduates). Do not compare the two directly.
